sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 240. Success value 100. 3x physical damage (Time).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Reduces all stats by 50% for 60 seconds.
-Target: all enemies. Increases physical and magic Ability Power of damage taken by 30 for 60 seconds.
-Removes Rejection from all allies.
-Target: all allies. Increases time elemental defense by 80 for 60 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Applies Serenity for 60 seconds (increases max HP, DEF, and MDEF by 100%; nullifies debuffs and Cost reduction. After the effect ends, your character's Unison gauge is filled by 100).
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 8000
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 8000
[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all allies excluding yourself. Fills Unison gauge by 25.
Only [Souped-Up] Metis can be used as Unlocking Potential material
